record.context_brief: Compact Abelian groups with extremal symmetry number
record.original_question: Fix an integer r ≥ 1. For a compact Abelian group G with Haar measure and central symmetries s_c(x) = c x^{-1} c, determine exactly which groups satisfy ms_r(G) = 1/r^2.

evidence.quote: Each group G will be endowed with the family of admissible symmetries S = {sc : c ∈ G} containing involutive transformations sc : x 7→ cx−1c, called central symmetries of the group G.
Problem 7.4. Given an integer number r, detect Abelian groups G with msr(G) = 1/r2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a compact Abelian topological group endowed with the normalized Haar measure $\mu$. For each $c \in G$, define the central symmetry $s_c : G \to G$ by $s_c(x) = c\,x^{-1}\,c$ (so $s_c$ is an involution of $G$), and let $\mathcal{S} = \{s_c : c \in G\}$. Call a Borel subset $A \subseteq G$ $\mathcal{S}$-symmetric if there exists $c \in G$ with $s_c(A) = A$.

For an integer $r \geq 1$ and a Borel measurable coloring $\chi : G \to \{1, 2, \dots, r\}$, set
$$\mathrm{ms}(\chi) \;=\; \sup\{\mu(A) : A \subseteq G \text{ Borel and } \mathcal{S}\text{-symmetric, and } \chi \text{ is constant on } A\},$$
and define the maximal symmetry number
$$\mathrm{ms}_r(G) \;=\; \inf\{\mathrm{ms}(\chi) : \chi : G \to \{1,\dots,r\} \text{ Borel measurable}\}.$$

It is known that $\mathrm{ms}_r(G) \geq 1/r^2$ for every compact Abelian group $G$ and every $r \geq 1$.

Problem. Fix $r \geq 1$. Characterize precisely those compact Abelian groups $G$ for which the equality
$$\mathrm{ms}_r(G) \;=\; \frac{1}{r^2}$$
holds.
artifact.category_tag: Symmetry numbers and colorings of topological groups
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as an open problem in Banakh's survey on symmetry and colorings (arXiv:1111.1015, 2011). Searches did not turn up a subsequent paper providing a complete characterization of compact Abelian groups attaining $\mathrm{ms}_r(G) = 1/r^2$, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Symmetry and colorings: some results and open problems, II
status_evidence.snippet: survey concentrating on the maximal symmetry numbers of geometric and algebraic objects endowed with symmetries
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed among open problems in this 2011 survey.
